# Sushaant Mujoo

> Senior Manager, Technical Program Management — Data Governance & Privacy Infrastructure at Meta. 20+ years in tech, 10 as a manager, across infrastructure, analytics, and privacy & security.

## About

- [About](https://sushaantmujoo.com/): career in three stints — infrastructure (IBM web middleware; Amgen OneCloud and Kubernetes), analytics (sales, marketing, and health analytics at Amgen), and privacy & security (Meta since 2018 — data understanding, lineage, purpose limitation, model training compliance, agentic safeguards).
- Hands-on as both an engineering manager and a TPM.
- Hired 150+ people over the years (100+ in a single site build-out); built teams of 20–30 people in different setups and improved their overall performance.
- Beyond work: strong believer in mindfulness and digital detox; Vipassana meditator, active practice — welcomes outreach on meditation and mindfulness; follows politics and society; avid cook, especially Kashmiri food.
- [Resume (PDF)](https://sushaantmujoo.com/resume.pdf): full resume. Web version has contact details removed.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sushaantmujoo)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/broodingGoat)
- [Medium](https://sushaantmujoo.medium.com/)
